coefficient_convention: Probabilists' Hermite projection under N(0,1), full exp(1/2) prefactor in all recipes
comparison_limitations: Legacy fixed Taylor controls use raw scores but decay all parameters; Hermite uses current selective decay.
The ongoing normalized Taylor rerun uses selective decay and QK-norm; it is not a matched raw-score control.
One seed per variant; a coefficient-only empirical comparison needs a matched fixed Taylor control.

prelaunch_kernel_qualification.scope: Fused FP32/BF16 outputs and QKV gradients for all eight coefficient/normalization combinations, including signed and zero denominator behavior. Each production allocation still runs its own acceptance checks.
